sections.name: MG ZS EV
lines: The M G Z S E V was one of the first electric SUVs sold in India, launched in 2020.
It has a fifty point three kilowatt hour battery, and a claimed range of four hundred and sixty one kilometres.
The motor makes a hundred and seventy six P S, and two hundred and eighty newton metres.
Charge it overnight on a home wallbox, or top up quickly at a D C fast charger.
Newer versions add level two driver assistance.
Inside, a panoramic sunroof, a digital cluster, and connected car tech.
It scored five stars in Euro N CAP crash tests.
A comfortable, proven electric SUV that helped start India's E V story.
